Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value for IC50 activities on target CHEMBL1795199. Join target_dictionary to assays to activities to molecule_dictionary, then INNER JOIN compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Filter standard_relation to exact '=' and pchembl_value not null. Do not deduplicate; keep every qualifying activity row. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit 1000 rows.
